reds_found_and_fixed.red: Local worker un-bootable: parseEnv hard-failed EVERY request (VALIDATION_ERROR) on wrangler dev — 9 integration secrets .min(1)-required + absent locally.
reds_found_and_fixed.root_cause: src/lib/env.ts EnvSchema made Stripe/Places/PostHog/CF secrets required unconditionally; app.use('*') runs parseEnv before every route.
reds_found_and_fixed.fix: buildEnvSchema(local) + isLocalDevEnv(): the 9 secrets are prod-required but optional when ENVIRONMENT in {development,dev,local,test}; prod stays fail-fast. parseEnv selects per-env.

reds_found_and_fixed.red: Local D1 schema incomplete -> /api/auth/me 'User not found' (users.is_super_admin + audit_logs.message absent).
reds_found_and_fixed.root_cause: wrangler d1 migrations apply --local breaks at 0010 (builds table only in 0504); only 9 core migrations applied, leaving an ancient schema.
reds_found_and_fixed.fix: Documented tolerant multi-pass sqlite3 apply in docs/local-dev-longtrail.md -> ~310 tables, is_super_admin + audit_logs.message present. (Local-recipe fix, not a prod migration change.)

reds_found_and_fixed.red: Orphaned test-login UI seam: ?test=1 panel lived only in unrouted pages/signin/signin.component.ts; router serves pages/auth/sign-in.component.ts (no panel) -> real-UI E2E login impossible.
reds_found_and_fixed.root_cause: Better Auth cutover repointed /signin to pages/auth/sign-in.component.ts; the test seam was never migrated (interconnectedness / orphaned-but-built feature; matches memory live-signin-is-auth-signin-component).
reds_found_and_fixed.fix: Wired the ?test=1 panel + testSignIn() into the SERVED SignInComponent (drives ApiService.testLogin -> POST /api/auth/test-login).
reds_found_and_fixed.verify: Panel renders at /signin?test=1; real login lands on /admin; spec green.

reds_found_and_fixed.red: No Angular->worker proxy: ng serve couldn't reach /api in dev.
reds_found_and_fixed.root_cause: angular.json serve had no proxyConfig; no proxy.conf.json existed.

reds_found_and_fixed.red: Spec test 1 failed on 2 locators (getByRole link 'Sign In'; ambiguous search placeholder).
reds_found_and_fixed.root_cause: Homepage 'Sign In' is a <button> not a <link>; two inputs share the search placeholder (hero + footer).
reds_found_and_fixed.fix: getByRole('button',{name:/Sign In/}) + getByTestId('hero-search-input') — discovered from the live DOM. Test-precision fix, product correct.
